Nothing was imported into UE: HDA asset registration, actor placement, capsule/BodySetup sweep, lighting, dressing fill and the packaged route remain pending (editor was held by another session). opening_sockets stay diagnostic JSON - no Houdini Engine mesh_socketX_* attributes are emitted yet.
